module.name: Qobuz
module.author: morieattonkatsu; Natune contributors
module.description: Natune fork: own-account Qobuz FLAC/MP3, signed requests using your app ID/secret, login and one session retry, bounded 429/503 cooldown and fallback only for an explicit unavailable format. Full tracks only; region follows the authenticated account.

appId.label: App ID
appId.description: Numeric Qobuz application ID used for API requests.

appSecret.label: App secret
appSecret.description: Secret paired with the app ID. Used to sign stream requests.

userAuthToken.label: User auth token
userAuthToken.description: Session token for your Qobuz account. Optional when email and password are set.

email.label: Email
email.description: Qobuz account email. Used with the password when no user auth token is set, or when the token expires.

password.label: Password
password.description: Qobuz account password. Sent only to Qobuz as an MD5 digest during sign-in.

qualityOptions.label: Hi-Res · FLAC up to 24-bit/192 kHz
qualityOptions.description: Highest available resolution. Qobuz serves a lower resolution when the track or plan does not include it.

qualityOptions.label: Hi-Res · FLAC up to 24-bit/96 kHz
qualityOptions.description: Hi-Res capped at 96 kHz to reduce data usage.

qualityOptions.label: MP3 · 320 kbps
qualityOptions.description: MP3 at 320 kbps to reduce data usage.
